svg.title: Built from scratch: WACC compiler: Scala 3 to x86-64: parser combinators, typed AST, two-stage IR backend. 180+ tests pass.; PintOS kernel: Priority donation across lock chains, a fixed-point MLFQS and 13 syscalls. 116/116 tests.; ARMv8 toolchain: Two-pass assembler and fetch-decode-execute emulator for AArch64, in C.; Transformer by hand: Built from scratch in NumPy, live-coded for an AI Society lecture.
